title: Motilal Padampat Sugar Mills Co. Ltd. v. State of Uttar Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Motilal Padampat Sugar Mills Co. Ltd. v. State of Uttar Pradesh, (1979) 2 SCC 409
content.facts: A State representation of sales-tax exemption induced establishment of a factory.
questionsBeforeCourt: What are the elements and scope of promissory estoppel against the State?
content.ratioDecidendi: A clear and intended promise, reliance and inequity may found promissory estoppel; consideration is not required in the conventional contractual sense, subject to recognised public-law limitations.
content.holding: The Court applied the doctrine against the State.
content.relevance: Use as the leading Indian exposition of promissory estoppel.
